title: golden session 4: the stubborn player (adolion-esha, Artemis)
objective: v2.8 24 golden session GS4. One adolion-fresh lane with Artemis v1.1 (3090 or pod), shipped defaults: thinking and inner voice on, judge on TypeSafe, warden on, agency notes in auto, authoring on Sol, images and sprites off. Story adolion-esha (a small cast, agency policies on several checkpoints, authored complications) in its own group, picked by id; the player declares outcomes, refuses the prepared road, hedges, writes OOC and goes quiet. Player lines are generic and name nothing from the campaign. 14 real player turns. Run twice back to back on one lane, run 2 from the seeded snapshot. The 40-turn over-steer card (33-W2-oversteer) is a separate informational so-session run (24 §Informational). Written, validated by the loader, not run yet.
